# device42_ip_nat (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_ip_nat" "myNewIpNat" {
   name            = "myNewIpNat"
   ip_address_from = "10.0.0.1"
   ip_address_to   = "172.16.0.1"
   notes           = "My new NAT rule"
   protocol        = "tcp"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address_from` (String) Source IP address of the NAT rule.
- `ip_address_to` (String) Destination IP address of the NAT rule. Create only: the API does not allow updating this field, so a change forces a recreate.
- `name` (String) Name of the IP NAT rule.

### Optional

- `ip_address_from_end` (String) End of the source IP address range.
- `ip_address_to_end` (String) End of the destination IP address range.
- `notes` (String) Any additional notes for the NAT rule.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the NAT rule (e.g. tcp, udp).
- `source_port_end` (String) End of the source port range.
- `source_port_start` (String) Start of the source port range.
- `target_port_end` (String) End of the target port range.
- `target_port_start` (String) Start of the target port range.
- `two_way_relation` (String) Whether the NAT is two-way. Defaults to `False`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
